arguments.prompt: Create one isolated Cartoon water effect for SPLASH.BMP frame005. First input is the exact original sprite: preserve its particular silhouette, proportions, relative positioning of parts, open transparent areas and number of significant tongues/drops. White source shapes are actual foam; black background is transparent and any dark diagnostic contour must not become dark water. Required form: A LOW WIDE collapsing splash bowl, ragged foam fringe with several short narrow tips, a few separate droplets above, and isolated thin broken ripple strokes below/around it. Preserve wide flattened proportions and original uneven waterline, transparent openings and sparse detached marks. No big vertical splash, no solid puddle or disk. Second input is a shared water materials/style key ONLY, not pose or amount of water. Use clean luminous white foam, pale cyan/light-blue restrained cel shading and thin medium-blue contour accents. NO heavy black outline, navy shadow, dark cast shadow, dark puddle, gray haze or glow. No animals, ground, scenery, ocean horizon or text. Do not turn thin open source forms into a generic solid mound. Real alpha transparency in all background and holes. Complete shape and every droplet fully inside a comfortably padded canvas. Crisp smooth Cartoon artwork, not literal pixel art.
